decision.summary: No open positions to manage and no valid new BTC price-hit entry this cycle.
decision.rationale: Reconciliation is ok, cash is available, and there are no open positions after the weekly 82k reach was closed for take profit. Latest Beecthor context remains macro bearish but explicitly allows an upside sweep toward 81k-85k before a later sell zone. Binance is still bullish at 81268 with BTC +1406.99 from the UTC open, +3.155% over 24h, and near the 24h high, so bearish DIP entries lack the required rejection evidence under the bearish-bias correction. Fresh bullish REACH entries would chase a large already-paid move; daily 82k is late after the extension, weekly 82k was just exited for take profit, and weekly 84k needs another leg without enough reset or breakout confirmation.
